name: one-annoyed-woman
why: Opens on one woman with a phone banning landmines in 14 months and pays off on five people in a Geneva office who can't fit their Nobel through the door, next to an accounting department to the horizon.

name: quiet-deaths
why: Hooks on 150,000 polite deaths a day that nobody films while every camera runs to one bomb, and pays off on the world's leaders bowing after-you into a conga line round the empty first chair.

name: the-bridge
why: A town that won't pay for its bridge drowns tipping its hats, then the same fat cat plays all four squares of the payoff grid and the only one where he waits ends with him a skeleton.
